column1: # Label map for the TCIA Healthy-Total-Body-CTs segmentations.
# Transcribed verbatim from the collection's own `segmentation_organ_values`
# spreadsheet (sheet "Segmentation Organ Values"), which defines Index as
# "corresponds to the segment number in the NIfTI image".
# ONLY 1-36 ARE HERE, DELIBERATELY. The spreadsheet lists 119 labels, but
# 37-119 are brain sub-structures (hippocampus, amygdala, temporal lobe parts)
# that are NOT present in these files -- measured: every subject's NIfTI
# contains exactly labels 1-36. Carrying the other 83 would mean the label map
# promised structures the asset does not have.
